why: From A to B the four outer lines turn 45 degrees: corner lines become lines to the middle of each side, and the cross inside the circle turns into an X. Do the same to C: the outer + lines must become corner (diagonal) lines, and the star pointing to the corners becomes a + inside. Option 1 has diagonal outer lines and a + inside, so it fits. Option 5 is tempting but its outer lines are still a +, so they did not turn.
trick: When figure B looks like figure A turned by 45 degrees, check that every part (inside and outside) has turned the same way.
note: Option 1 in the scan has faint, partly broken corner lines; drawn as full diagonals. Inner shape change (black square to black circle) is taken as shown by the book.
